mapper.select: SELECT p.POLICY_SEQ AS policySeq, p.CUST_SEQ AS custSeq, c.GRADE_CD AS gradeCd FROM TB_POLICY p JOIN TB_CUSTOMER c ON c.CUST_SEQ = p.CUST_SEQ WHERE p.POLICY_SEQ = #{policySeq}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_CLAIM.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_CLAIM ( CLAIM_SEQ, CLAIM_NO, POLICY_SEQ, CLAIM_TYPE, STATUS_CD, ACCIDENT_DTM, CLAIM_AMT, DISCOUNT_RATE, GRADE_CD, REG_ID, UPD_ID ) VALUES ( #{claimSeq}, 'CLM' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(#{claimSeq}), 12, '0'), #{policySeq}, #{claimType}, NVL(#{statusCd}, 'RECEIPT'), #{accidentDtm}, #{claimAmt}, #{discountRate}, #{gradeCd}, #{regId}, #{updId} )

INSERT INTO TB_AUDIT_LOG ( LOG_SEQ, ACTION_CD, TARGET_TABLE, TARGET_SEQ, BEFORE_VALUE, AFTER_VALUE, USER_ID, CLIENT_IP, REG_DTM, REG_ID, UPD_DTM, UPD_ID ) VALUES ( SEQ_AUDIT_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{actionCd}, #{targetTable}, #{targetSeq}, #{beforeValue,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{afterValue,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{userId}, #{clientIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{regId}, SYSDATE, #{updId} )
mapper.select: SELECT CLAIM_SEQ AS claimSeq, CLAIM_NO AS claimNo, POLICY_SEQ AS policySeq, CLAIM_TYPE AS claimType, STATUS_CD AS statusCd, ACCIDENT_DTM AS accidentDtm, RECEIPT_DTM AS receiptDtm, CLAIM_AMT AS claimAmt, APPROVED_AMT AS approvedAmt, DISCOUNT_RATE AS discountRate, GRADE_CD AS gradeCd, REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason FROM TB_CLAIM WHERE CLAIM_SEQ = #{claimSeq}
